title: 2026 United States Senate election in Utah
description: This race is for one of Utah's two seats in the United States Senate. Ballotpedia did not return a candidate roster for this race, so the candidate list here is limited to contenders corroborated by Utah's official 2026 candidate filings and other published sources. Incumbent Republican Mike Lee is an active federal candidate according to the FEC, while Democrat Brian King is included based on published candidate references and public biography sources, though the available official Utah filing page text fetched for this run did not expose the U.S. Senate subsection. candidates.name: Mike Lee
candidates.summary: Mike Lee is the incumbent U.S. senator from Utah, first elected in 2010 and serving since 2011. His Senate biography says he previously worked as an attorney, assistant U.S. attorney, law clerk, and counsel to then-Gov. Jon Huntsman. FEC records show he has filed as an incumbent candidate for Utah Senate in the current cycle.
